subject_line: From The Raven's Gift to the poems of Without a Paddle
email_body:
Dear Don,

I've been reading about Without a Paddle, described as your first book of poems, and the way its pieces draw on a life lived and remembered in Southwest Alaska, the same ground that shaped your novel The Raven's Gift. I'd be curious to ask what poetry allowed you to say about that place that fiction and co-written memoir did not, and how teaching at UAA feeds back into your own work.

hook_note: Without a Paddle is his first poetry collection (KYUK, Alaska Public 2023); grew up in SW Alaska, novel The Raven's Gift; UAA writing professor. Email seen in search result from Poets & Writers directory listing.

book_title: Beautiful Is the World: New and Selected Poems, 1996-2026
subject_line: Thirty years of poems in Beautiful Is the World
email_body:
Dear David,

I saw that Unbound Edition Press is bringing out Beautiful Is the World: New and Selected Poems, 1996-2026 this September, your fourteenth book. A new and selected spanning three decades must have meant rereading a great deal of your own work, from The Book of Men and Women to the epistolary poems of Charming Gardeners. I'd like to ask what that rereading taught you, and which early poems you found yourself quarrelling with.
